pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are clearly visible with varying path thickness, generally wider on the neck area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous jagged 1D profile of the mane along the upper neck, exhibiting low-amplitude and high-frequency serration against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct avian silhouettes are observed perched on the dorsal and lateral surfaces of the upper neck.
